note: Controlled vocabulary for the UAP Shape Census. Each shape has two alias lists: `aliases` (HIGH confidence — shape-explicit terms that rarely mean anything but a craft; these get PUBLISHED to the committed data) and `review_aliases` (ambiguous common words that need human/LLM context; these are captured locally in work/mentions.full.json but are NOT committed by default — see build.py --include-review and PLAN-ufo-shapes.md §11). Matching is whole-word, case-insensitive; internal spaces match flexible whitespace + optional hyphen. GROW these lists as real prose reveals new terms, and bump `version` when you do.

shapes.label: Disc
shapes.disambiguation: Classic 'flying saucer'. 'disc'/'disk' are kept high (in UFO prose they overwhelmingly mean the craft); 'plate'/'dish' are review (literal tableware/satellite dish).

shapes.label: Sphere / Orb
shapes.disambiguation: Shape-explicit forms high; bare 'ball'/'globe'/'round' are review (ball game, round trip).

shapes.label: Triangle
shapes.disambiguation: Belgian-wave / Phoenix-Lights morphology. Bare 'delta' (river/airline) and 'wedge' are review.

shapes.label: Boomerang / Chevron
shapes.disambiguation: Open/bent/winged shape, distinct from a solid triangle. Bare 'crescent' (moon) and 'winged' (bird/metaphor) are review.

shapes.label: Cylinder / Cigar
shapes.disambiguation: Long-axis craft, kept separate from Tic-Tac. Bare 'tube'/'rod' are review (literal).

shapes.label: Tic-Tac / Pill
shapes.disambiguation: Own bucket — iconic, time-stamped post-2004 (Nimitz). Bare 'pill' (medication) and 'capsule' (space capsule) are review.

shapes.label: Egg / Ovoid
shapes.disambiguation: Includes the teardrop/acorn crash-retrieval morphology. Bare 'egg'/'oval'/'acorn' are review.

shapes.label: Cone
shapes.disambiguation: Bare 'bell' was removed in v2 (surname/Bell Helicopter). Bare 'cone' (ice-cream/traffic) is review; require 'cone-shaped'/'conical'.

shapes.label: Diamond
shapes.disambiguation: Shape-explicit forms high; bare 'diamond' (gemstone/baseball) is review.

shapes.label: Cube / Box
shapes.disambiguation: Bare 'box'/'square'/'block' removed in v2 (metaphors). Require shape-qualified forms; bare 'cube' is review.

shapes.label: Other / Unspecified
shapes.disambiguation: Catch-all for explicitly unspecified / shape-shifting morphology. Only matched on these explicit phrases, never a default dumping ground.
